market_pulse.note: Closed Thursday at 52,297.09, down 189.40 points or 0.36% (Yahoo Finance).
Closed Thursday at 7,592.40, down 26.98 points or 0.35% (Yahoo Finance), after an early dip and a midday move into positive territory. 24/7 Wall St. reported a slightly larger decline of about 0.43%.
Closed Thursday at 25,366.09, down 100.10 points or 0.39% (Yahoo Finance), as rate-hike expectations weighed on growth stocks (24/7 Wall St.).

Rose about 2.8% to near $88.95 a barrel Thursday, a second straight gain after a ten-week low near $86 on Nov. 10 (Trading Economics). Brent traded above $94, up about 1.4% (The Private Banker, citing Bloomberg).

themes.title: Nvidia falls after Jensen Huang resigns
themes.summary: Nvidia closed at $166.19, down 4.34%, after CEO Jensen Huang stepped down; the stock had fallen as much as 13% to 14% early before recovering more than half of the loss (Yahoo Finance; 24/7 Wall St.).

themes.title: 10-year yield climbs above 5%
themes.summary: The 10-year Treasury yield rose about 10 basis points to 5.10%, briefly touching 5.12%, as markets priced in a possible Fed rate hike in December after a hotter-than-expected October inflation report (Yahoo Finance).

themes.title: Oil jumps on Trump's Iran remarks
themes.summary: Crude reversed early losses after President Trump said the U.S. no longer needs a deal with Iran, clouding a plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz (Trading Economics; The Private Banker).

themes.title: Chipmakers split
themes.summary: Broadcom rose 5.5% and AMD gained 5.3%, while Intel and Micron fell and Applied Materials slipped ahead of its earnings report (24/7 Wall St.; Yahoo Finance).

themes.title: Jobless claims tick up
themes.summary: Initial jobless claims rose 9,000 to 200,000 for the week ended Nov. 7, above the 195,000 expected; the four-week average was 195,250 (Yahoo Finance).

sectors.name: Technology
sectors.note: Tech was the weakest S&P 500 sector in the morning, down about 0.9% at 10:30 a.m. ET, with Nvidia's drop offset in part by gains in Broadcom and AMD (24/7 Wall St.; Yahoo Finance).

sectors.name: Energy
sectors.note: Energy led the sectors in the morning, up about 0.9% at 10:30 a.m. ET, as oil rose; Equinor gained 3.4% (24/7 Wall St.).

sectors.name: Small Caps
sectors.note: The Russell 2000 fell 1.66% to 2,799.06, underperforming the large-cap indexes as yields rose (Yahoo Finance).

sectors.name: Speculative Growth
sectors.note: Archer Aviation and Lucid fell about 11%, IonQ fell 9.5% and Joby Aviation fell 8.9% (24/7 Wall St.).

watch_list.why: Both reported after Thursday's close, so Friday's trading will show the first full reaction to their results (Yahoo Finance).
Nvidia reports results Tuesday, Nov. 17, and the Anthropic IPO is set to price Wednesday, Nov. 18, with trading expected Nov. 19 (Yahoo Finance).
The October PPI report is due Friday morning and is another inflation reading ahead of the Fed's December meeting (The Crypto Desk; Yahoo Finance).
